name: GAN Training Procedure
aliases: GAN Training Procedure — GANs, Generative Adversarial Networks, Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), Min-Max Game Training
definition: A GAN trains a generator against a discriminator to produce perceptually realistic outputs rather than merely minimize pixelwise error. This perceptual advantage makes GANs well-suited for volume SR, where MSE-optimized outputs tend toward oversmoothing.
summary: GAN Training trains a generator against a discriminator to produce perceptually realistic volume renders, avoiding the oversmoothing typical of pixelwise error minimization.
